company_description: Welltower Inc. is a S&P 500 company, is positioned at the center of the silver economy, focusing on rental housing for aging seniors across the United States, United Kingdom and Canada. Our portfolio of 2,000+ seniors and wellness housing communities are positioned at the intersection of housing and hospitality, creating vibrant communities for mature renters and older adults. We believe our real estate portfolio is unmatched, located in highly attractive micro markets with stunning built environments. Yet, we are an unusual real estate organization as we view ourselves as an operating company in a real estate wrapper, driven by highly aligned partnerships and an unconventional culture. Through our disciplined approach to capital allocation powered by our Data Science platform and superior operating results driven by the Welltower Business System - our end-to-end operating platform - we aspire to deliver long-term compounding of per share growth for our existing investors, our North Star. Welltower Inc. was incorporated in 1970 and is based in Toledo, United States.

risks.title: Dégradation des notations de crédit
risks.score_rationale: Risque positionné en section Capital Structure (milieu du rapport), langage fort 'material adverse impact' répété deux fois, tendance stable mais structure de dette complexe accrue (31 Md$ d'obligations contractuelles), catégorie crédit pondérée fortement pour REIT. Citation: "Reductions in the Medicaid population and in Medicaid rates could reduce the revenue and operating". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Toute dégradation de notation par les agences de rating augmenterait directement les frais et taux d'intérêt sur la ligne de crédit principale, impactant gravement la liquidité et les résultats opérationnels de la société.
risks.citation: Any downgrades in terms of ratings or outlook by any or all of the rating agencies could have a material adverse impact on our cost and availability of capital, which could have a material adverse impact on our consolidated results of operations, liquidity and/or financial condition.

risks.title: Risque de refinancement de la dette
risks.score_rationale: Position milieu du rapport (section Liquidity and Capital Resources), obligations contractuelles massives (31,1 Md$ total, 4,3 Md$ dus en 2026), langage implicite 'depending upon availability and cost of external capital', tendance accrue avec investissements en hausse de 91% en activités d'investissement. Citation: "Rates paid by self-pay residents are set by the facilities and are determined by local". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: La société doit refinancer régulièrement une dette importante (700 M$ en 2026, 2,3 Md$ en 2027-2028) et dépend de l'accès aux marchés de capitaux. Une restriction d'accès ou une hausse des taux pourrait compromettre sa capacité à financer ses acquisitions et dividendes.
risks.citation: Depending upon the availability and cost of external capital, we believe our liquidity is sufficient to fund these uses of cash.

risks.title: Concentration du risque de change
risks.score_rationale: Position milieu du rapport (section Foreign Currency Translation et obligations contractuelles), exposition explicite en CAD et GBP (2,4 Md$ en dettes étrangères), langage neutre mais volatilité observée (129 M$ de variation en 2025), tendance nouvelle avec transaction Amica pré-financée en CAD. Citation: "Consequently, changes in federal or state reimbursement policies may adversely affect an operator s ability". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: La société détient des dettes en dollars canadiens et livres sterling, et pré-finance des acquisitions en devises étrangères. Les fluctuations de change peuvent affecter la valeur de ces obligations et les flux de trésorerie consolidés.
risks.citation: The change in cash from foreign currency translation during the twelve months ended December 31, 2025 is primarily due to the mark-to-market adjustment of Canadian dollar funds held by Canadian subsidiaries to pre-fund the Amica Senior Lifestyles transaction.

risks.title: Obligations de put-call non consolidees
risks.score_rationale: Position milieu du rapport (section Off-Balance Sheet Arrangements), exposition contingente de 375,7 M$ si conditions déclenchées, langage factuel mais risque caché hors bilan, tendance stable mais montant significatif pour acquisitions futures. Citation: "As we use data to better inform our investments and the efficacy of care in". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: La société a signé des accords put-call sur des projets de développement qui pourraient l'obliger à acquérir des propriétés pour 375,7 M$ si certaines conditions sont remplies, créant une obligation potentielle non visible au bilan.
risks.citation: If all conditions had been met under these agreements as of December 31, 2025, and the put or call rights for each investment had been triggered, the amount payable by us to acquire these properties would have been $375,660,000.

risks.title: Dilution actionnariale par emissions massives
risks.score_rationale: Position milieu du rapport (section Capital Structure et Financing Activities), emissions massives documentees (70,4 M$ d'actions en 2024, 7,5 Md$ de capacite ATM), langage neutre mais dilution continue, tendance accrue avec renouvellement du programme ATM en octobre 2025. Citation: "At least one federal judge has held that federal qui tam provisions are unconstitutional, though". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: La société a émis 70,4 millions d'actions en 2024 et dispose de 5,6 Md$ de capacité d'émission restante sous son programme ATM, créant un risque de dilution significative pour les actionnaires existants.
risks.citation: During the year ended December 31, 2024, we sold 70,419,530 shares of common stock under our ATM Programs, generating gross proceeds of approximately $7,452,108,000.

risks.title: Augmentation des depenses d'investissement
risks.score_rationale: Position milieu du rapport (section Investing Activities), activites d'investissement en hausse de 91% (4,99 Md$ supplementaires), langage neutre mais tendance accrue, renovations et redeveloppements en hausse de 19%, nouveau developpement en baisse de 47%. Citation: "Health Reform Laws Certain health reform measures could be implemented as a result of political". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Les dépenses d'investissement immobilier ont augmenté de 91% en 2025, notamment en rénovations et redéveloppements (675,8 M$), créant une pression accrue sur les flux de trésorerie et la capacité de financement.
risks.citation: The changes in net cash provided from/used in investing activities are primarily attributable to net changes in real property investments and dispositions, loans receivable and investments in unconsolidated entities.

risks.title: Risque de non-conformite aux covenants
risks.score_rationale: Position milieu du rapport (section Capital Structure), langage affirmatif 'in compliance in all material respects' mais covenants multiples et restrictifs (ratios financiers, net worth minimum, limites d'endettement), tendance stable mais structure complexe avec 31 Md$ d'obligations. Citation: "The relevant regulatory body for England is the Care Quality Commission, for Wales is the". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.summary: Les accords de dette contiennent des covenants exigeant le maintien de ratios financiers, de net worth minimum et limitant l'endettement et les acquisitions. Tout manquement pourrait declencher des clauses de defaut.
risks.citation: Our debt agreements contain various covenants, restrictions and events of default. Certain agreements require us to maintain financial ratios and minimum net worth and impose certain limits on our ability to incur indebtedness, create liens and make investments or acquisitions.
